#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Atomic deploy for myapp
#
#   * Unpacks a new release under /srv/myapp/releases/<timestamp>
#   * Swaps the /srv/myapp/current symlink atomically
#   * Runs a health‑check against http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz
#   * On failure restores the previous symlink target
#   * All actions are logged to /srv/myapp/deploy.log
#
#   The script follows the constraints from:
#     - docs/deploy_requirements.md
#     - docs/ops_constraints.md
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1️⃣  Safety & strict mode (ops_constraints.md)
set -euo pipefail

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2️⃣  Configuration (derived from docs/deploy_requirements.md)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
APP_ROOT="/srv/myapp"
RELEASES_DIR="${APP_ROOT}/releases"
CURRENT_LINK="${APP_ROOT}/current"
LOG_FILE="${APP_ROOT}/deploy.log"
HEALTH_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3️⃣  Helper functions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
log() {
    local msg="$1"
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ${msg}" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
}

die() {
    log "ERROR: $*"
    exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4️⃣  Preconditions (ops_constraints.md)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# a) The current symlink must exist (or be a valid directory)
if [[ ! -L "${CURRENT_LINK}" && ! -d "${CURRENT_LINK}" ]]; then
    die "Current symlink ${CURRENT_LINK} is missing – aborting."
fi

# b) Verify we have a previous release to roll back to
#    (the first deploy will have no previous release – that's fine)
PREV_RELEASE=$(readlink -f "${CURRENT_LINK}" 2>/dev/null || true)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5️⃣  Main deployment
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
log "=== START DEPLOY ==="

# 5.1  Build a timestamped release directory
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
RELEASE_DIR="${RELEASES_DIR}/${TIMESTAMP}"
log "Unpacking new release to ${RELEASE_DIR}"

# NOTE: Replace the following line with your real unpack command.
# Example: tar -xzf "/tmp/myapp-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz" -C "${RELEASE_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${RELEASE_DIR}" || die "Failed to create release directory"

# 5.2  Atomically switch the symlink
# We first link to a *new* path, then move it into place with ln -sfn.
# This guarantees that at any instant the symlink points to either the old
# or the new release – never a half‑written directory.
NEW_LINK_PATH="${RELEASE_DIR}"
ln -sfn "${NEW_LINK_PATH}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"
log "Swapped symlink: ${CURRENT_LINK} -> ${NEW_LINK_PATH}"

# 5.3  Health check (do NOT delete the old release yet)
log "Running health check against ${HEALTH_URL}"
MAX_ATTEMPTS=30
ATTEMPT
